technical.summary: LDOS shows long-term bullish MA alignment but is in acute downtrend with extreme oversold conditions, negative momentum, and no reversal confirmation—high risk of further capitulation before any bounce.

fundamental.summary: LDOS shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 4 days create elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) and heavily bearish AAII sentiment (59% bearish) create contrarian buy conditions; congressional selling is minimal and dated (141+ days old), providing weak bearish confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (443.36), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings (4 days) create a highly adverse macro and event-driven risk environment for LDOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term MA alignment (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200 bullish) + extreme oversold RSI (8.75, 22.82) + contrarian extreme fear sentiment (20/100) create classic capitulation setup with asymmetric risk/reward if reversal confirms.
debate.key_bear_argument: Acute downtrend with zero reversal confirmation (no MACD bullish crossover, negative CMF, OBV not rising, three black crows pattern), imminent earnings in 4 days, crisis VIX, and price rejected from all short-term MAs—oversold conditions alone are insufficient without momentum confirmation and macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and contrarian fear sentiment create theoretical capitulation setup, but lack of momentum confirmation (negative MACD, CMF, OBV) and price rejection from all short-term MAs eliminate confluence entry signal required for swing trade conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 4 days combined with crisis VIX (443.36) and acute downtrend creates uncontrollable event risk; further capitulation likely before any reversal confirmation materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all flag insufficient entry quality; only sentiment provides contrarian support, insufficient to override structural weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 10 positions in Industrials sector; adding LDOS would increase concentration risk without conviction improvement.
